paragraphs.title: Samuel Is Sent to Anoint a New King

easy.explanation: The Lord told Samuel to stop mourning for Saul.
easy.q: Whom was Samuel told to stop mourning?

easy.explanation: The Lord sent Samuel to Jesse the Bethlehemite.
The Lord told Samuel, "Take an heifer with thee."
easy.q: What was Samuel told to take with him?

answers: The elders would not know him
medium.explanation: Samuel feared that Saul would hear about his mission and kill him.
medium.q: Why was Samuel afraid to go to Bethlehem?

answers: He had come to teach Jesse's sons
He had come to seek a warrior
He had come to sacrifice unto the Lord
medium.explanation: The Lord told Samuel to say, "I am come to sacrifice to the Lord."
medium.q: What was Samuel instructed to say about the purpose of his visit?

answers: He sanctified Jesse and his sons and called them to the sacrifice
He went to search for David among the sheep
medium.explanation: Samuel sanctified Jesse and his sons and called them to the sacrifice.
medium.q: What did Samuel do after arriving in Bethlehem?

answers: To anoint a king from among Jesse's sons
challenge.explanation: God sent Samuel to anoint the king He had provided among Jesse's sons.
challenge.q: What was the true purpose of Samuel's mission?

answers: A trumpet for announcing the king
challenge.explanation: Samuel was to fill a horn, a container, with oil for anointing.
challenge.q: What does the word "horn" refer to in the command, "fill thine horn with oil"?

answers: He hid Jesse from the elders
He used the sacrifice as the setting for his visit
He sent David in his place
challenge.explanation: Samuel truthfully came to sacrifice and used that occasion to meet Jesse and his sons.
challenge.q: How did Samuel combine his public visit with his secret mission?

paragraphs.title: David Is Chosen from Among Jesse's Sons

easy.explanation: When Samuel saw Eliab, he thought the Lord's anointed was before him.
easy.q: Which son impressed Samuel at first?

answers: He made his sons pass before Samuel
He sent all his sons to war
easy.explanation: Jesse made his sons pass before Samuel one by one.
easy.q: What did Jesse do before Samuel?

easy.explanation: David was the youngest and was keeping the sheep.
easy.q: Where was David when his brothers passed before Samuel?

answers: God's choice is not based on outward appearance
medium.explanation: The Lord said that man looks on the outward appearance, but the Lord looks on the heart.
medium.q: Why did the Lord reject Eliab?

medium.explanation: The word "ruddy" describes David's reddish appearance.
medium.q: What does "ruddy" mean in the description of David?

answers: Samuel asked whether all the children were present
medium.explanation: Samuel asked whether these were all Jesse's children, and Jesse mentioned the youngest.
medium.q: What happened after Jesse's other sons passed before Samuel?

challenge.explanation: The Lord contrasts man's outward sight with His looking upon the heart.
challenge.q: What central contrast appears in the Lord's words to Samuel?

answers: David was not present at the beginning of the selection
challenge.explanation: David remained with the sheep until Jesse sent for him.
challenge.q: What can be inferred from David being brought in only after his brothers had passed before Samuel?

answers: The Spirit of the Lord came upon him
challenge.explanation: The Spirit of the Lord came upon David from that day forward.
challenge.q: What happened to David immediately after he was anointed?

easy.explanation: The Spirit of the Lord departed from Saul.

answers: A man who could play the harp
easy.explanation: They suggested finding a man who was a cunning player on a harp.
easy.q: What kind of person did Saul's servants suggest finding?

easy.explanation: One of Saul's servants had seen David and recommended him.

answers: The servants would leave the palace
medium.explanation: The servants said that playing the harp would make Saul well.
medium.q: What did the servants say would happen when the harp was played?

medium.explanation: The servant described David as prudent in matters.
medium.q: Which description was included in the servant's description of David?

medium.explanation: The passage calls it an evil spirit from the Lord.
medium.q: According to the passage, from where did the evil spirit come?

answers: They proposed a practical and soothing remedy
They proposed sending Saul to Bethlehem
challenge.explanation: They suggested music as a practical way to bring Saul relief.
challenge.q: What can be inferred from the servants' suggestion for helping Saul?

answers: To present him as a man of many abilities
To show that he was unfit to play music
To prove that he was already king
challenge.explanation: The servant describes David as a musician, warrior, wise man, and handsome person.
challenge.q: Why does the description of David include both musical ability and warrior qualities?

challenge.explanation: The description ends with the statement, "the Lord is with him."
challenge.q: Which detail in David's description emphasizes his relationship with God?

paragraphs.title: David Enters Saul's Court and Calms Him with Music

answers: Oil, a harp, and a sword
easy.explanation: Jesse sent an ass laden with bread, a bottle of wine, and a kid.
easy.q: What did Jesse send with David?

easy.explanation: David took a harp and played with his hand.
easy.q: What did David do when the evil spirit troubled Saul?

medium.explanation: Saul loved David greatly, and David became his armourbearer.
medium.q: What position did David have with Saul?

answers: David had found favour in Saul's sight
medium.explanation: Saul asked Jesse to let David remain because David had found favour in his sight.
medium.q: Why did Saul ask Jesse to leave David before him?

medium.explanation: Saul was refreshed and well, and the evil spirit departed from him.
medium.q: What was the result of David's playing?

answers: David was anointed and afterward brought before Saul
David was brought before Saul and only afterward anointed
challenge.explanation: After David was anointed, he was recommended to Saul and brought to his court.
challenge.q: What connection is shown between David's anointing and his arrival at Saul's court?

challenge.explanation: The passage says that Saul loved David greatly and that David found favour in his sight.
challenge.q: What can be learned from Saul loving David despite David's young age?

answers: David played, Jesse sent him, and Saul summoned him
Saul summoned a musician, Jesse sent David, and David played
Jesse sent David, David was anointed, and Saul searched for a harp
challenge.explanation: Saul asked for a skilled musician, Jesse sent David, and David played before Saul.
challenge.q: Which sequence correctly describes the events?
